_about: Condor agent runtime config, read like Albatross's agent.config.json. Edits apply on the next tick or turn; no restart. Check with: uv run python -m condor.agent_config

budget._dailyRequestCap: Sized for the load, not the free tier: the spot desk (hourly), the futures desk (every 15 min) and the free analyst consults come to roughly 1,200-1,700 requests a day. Paid requests are bounded in dollars by monthlyCostCapUsd; free ones cannot reach OpenRouter's own 1,000-a-day free-model limit (analysts are about 430 at most). A cap of 1,000 would have refused the desks late in each UTC day.
budget._monthlyCostCapUsd: Hard UTC calendar-month ceiling on paid model spend, in dollars. Paid requests reserve requestCostReserveUsd before they go out, free models are exempt, and a response whose price is unknown is booked at the reserve. Only allowedPaidModels may spend. Each is pinned to one provider (openrouterProviderOnly) and to paidPriceCeilingUsdPerMillion, set just above wafer/mxfp4's price verified 2026-11-05 ($0.16/M in, $0.50/M out); a dearer endpoint fails with 404 instead of overspending. The validator rejects a requestCostReserveUsd below the worst case that ceiling allows. Verified provider spend so far this month is booked in data/llm_budget/spend-baseline.json.
